Require Export strictness.cbpv.typing strictness.cbpv.semantics.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import Coq.Logic.Eqdep_dec.

Require Import Coq.Arith.Peano_dec.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Require Import Psatz.

Definition non_func {n} (B : CompTy n) :=
  forall q A B', B <> CAbs q A B'.

Definition LRM {n} (B : Ty n CompFlag)
  (LR_maybe : Ty n CompFlag -> Clos CompFlag -> forall m,fin m -> Prop)
  (LR_no : Ty n CompFlag -> Clos CompFlag -> forall m,fin m -> Prop)
 mInner (γ : attrs mInner) mOuter mLower x (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner) ρ M :=
  ((down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) x = Strict ->
    (non_func B -> EvalCompFail ρ M) /\
    (~ non_func B -> EvalCompFail ρ M \/ exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\
      LR_no B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower x)) /\
  ((down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) x <> Strict ->
    EvalCompFail ρ M \/ exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\ LR_maybe B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower x).

Fixpoint LR_maybe {n k} (τ : Ty n k) (C : Clos k) mLower (x : fin mLower) :=
    (match τ in Ty _ k return Clos k -> Prop with
    | VUnit => fun C => C = Unit
    | VThunk γ B => fun C =>
      exists mOuter mInner γScoped γInner ρ M (HInner : mOuter <= mInner)
        (Hn : mOuter <= n) (HLower : mLower <= mOuter) (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner),
        down_env_until γ mOuter Hn = γScoped /\
        down_env_until γInner mOuter HInner = γScoped /\
        C = Thunk mOuter mInner γScoped ρ M /\
        LRM B LR_maybe LR_no mInner γInner mOuter mLower x Hnlower ρ M
    | VProd A1 A2 => fun C => exists W1 W2,
      C = Pair W1 W2 /\ LR_maybe A1 W1 mLower x /\ LR_maybe A2 W2 mLower x
    | VSum A1 A2 => fun C => exists W',
      (C = Inl W' /\ LR_maybe A1 W' mLower x) \/ (C = Inr W' /\ LR_maybe A2 W' mLower x)
    | CF A => fun C => exists W, C = Return W /\ LR_maybe A W mLower x
    | CAbs q A B => fun C =>
      exists mOuter mInner γScoped γInner ρ M (Hn : mOuter <= n)
        (HInner : mOuter <= mInner) (HLower : mLower <= mOuter) (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner),
      down_env_until γInner mOuter HInner = γScoped /\
      C = Closure mOuter mInner γScoped ρ M /\
      (forall W, LR_maybe A W mLower x ->
        EvalCompFail ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M \/
        exists T, EvalComp (q .: γInner) ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M T /\ LR_maybe B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower x)
    end) C

with LR_no {n k} (τ : Ty n k) (C : Clos k) mLower (x : fin mLower) :=
    (match τ in Ty _ k return Clos k -> Prop with
    | CAbs q A B => fun C =>
      exists mOuter mInner γScoped γInner ρ M (Hn : mOuter <= n) (HInner : mOuter <= mInner)
        (HLower : mLower <= mOuter) (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner),
      down_env_until γInner mOuter HInner = γScoped /\
      C = Closure mOuter mInner γScoped ρ M /\
      (forall W, LR_maybe A W mLower x ->
        (non_func B -> EvalCompFail ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M) /\
        (~ non_func B -> EvalCompFail ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M \/
            exists T, EvalComp (q .: γInner) ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M T /\ LR_no B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower x))
    | _ => fun C => False
    end) C.

Definition ρ_not_ok {n} γ (ρ : env n) (Γ : context n) mLower (x : fin mLower) (Hnlower : mLower <= n) :=
    (down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) x = Strict /\
    (down_env_until ρ mLower Hnlower) x = Absent /\
    (forall (j : fin n), j <> up_fin_until n Hnlower x -> LR_maybe (Γ j) (ρ j) mLower x).

Definition ρ_maybe_ok {n} γ (ρ : env n) (Γ : context n) mLower (x : fin mLower) (Hnlower : mLower <= n) :=
    (down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) x <> Strict /\
    (down_env_until ρ mLower Hnlower) x = Absent /\
    (forall (j : fin n), j <> up_fin_until n Hnlower x -> LR_maybe (Γ j) (ρ j) mLower x).

Definition SemVWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) V (A : ValTy n) :=
    forall ρ mLower x (Hnlower : mLower <= n),
        (ρ_not_ok γ ρ Γ mLower x Hnlower -> EvalValFail ρ V) /\
        (ρ_maybe_ok γ ρ Γ mLower x Hnlower ->
          EvalValFail ρ V \/ exists W, EvalVal γ ρ V W /\ LR_maybe A W mLower x).

Definition SemCWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) M (B : CompTy n) :=
    forall ρ mLower x (Hnlower : mLower <= n),
        (ρ_not_ok γ ρ Γ mLower x Hnlower ->
            (non_func B -> EvalCompFail ρ M) /\
            (~ non_func B -> EvalCompFail ρ M \/ exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\ LR_no B T mLower x)) /\
        (ρ_maybe_ok γ ρ Γ mLower x Hnlower ->
            EvalCompFail ρ M \/ exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\ LR_maybe B T mLower x).

Section SemTyping.

Context {n : nat} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n).

End SemTyping.

1	Require Export strictness.cbpv.syntax.
2	
3	Require Import Psatz.
4	
5	From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.
6	
7	Definition context n : Type := fin n -> ValTy n.
8	
9	Definition ctx_insert {n} (A : ValTy n) (Γ : context n) : context (S n) :=
10	    (Lazy A↑ A) .: (fun fn => Lazy A↑ (Γ fn)).
11	
12	Inductive VWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Val n -> ValTy n -> Prop :=
13	  | T_Var i A :
14	    A = Γ i ->
15	    γ = (lazyvector <- Strict @ i) ->
16	
17	    VWt γ Γ (vVar i) A
18	
19	  | T_Unit :
20	    γ = lazyvector ->
21	
22	    VWt γ Γ vUnit VUnit
23	
24	  | T_Thunk γ' M B :
25	    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
26	    γ = lazyvector ->
27	
28	    VWt γ Γ (vThunk M) (VThunk γ' B)
29	
30	  | T_Pair γ1 γ2 V1 V2 A1 A2 :
31	    VWt γ1 Γ V1 A1 ->
32	    VWt γ2 Γ V2 A2 ->
33	    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
34	
35	    VWt γ Γ (vPair V1 V2) (VProd A1 A2)
36	
37	  | T_Inl V1 A1 A2 :
38	    VWt γ Γ V1 A1 ->
39	
40	    VWt γ Γ (vInl V1) (VSum A1 A2)
41	
42	  | T_Inr V2 A1 A2 :
43	    VWt γ Γ V2 A2 ->
44	
45	    VWt γ Γ (vInr V2) (VSum A1 A2)
46	
47	with CWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Comp n -> CompTy n -> Prop :=
48	  | T_Ret V A :
49	    VWt γ Γ V A ->
50	
51	    CWt γ Γ (cRet V) (CF A)
52	
53	  | T_Let q M M' A B B' γ1 γ2:
54	    CWt γ1 Γ M (CF A) ->
55	    CWt (q .: γ2) (ctx_insert A Γ) M' B' ->
56	    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
57	    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->
58	
59	    CWt γ Γ (cLet M M') B
60	
61	  | T_Force V B γ1 γ2 :
62	    VWt γ1 Γ V (VThunk γ2 B) ->
63	    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
64	
65	    CWt γ Γ (cForce V) B
66	
67	  | T_Seq V M B γ1 γ2 :
68	    VWt γ1 Γ V VUnit ->
69	    CWt γ2 Γ M B ->
70	    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
71	
72	    CWt γ Γ (cSeq V M) B
73	
74	  | T_Split q1 q2 V M γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B':
75	    VWt γ1 Γ V (VProd A1 A2) ->
76	    CWt (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2)) (ctx_insert (Lazy A↑ A1) (ctx_insert A2 Γ)) M B' ->
77	    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
78	    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (le_succ_succ_diag_r n)) ->
79	
80	    CWt γ Γ (cSplit V M) B
81	
82	  | T_Case q1 q2 V M1 M2 γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B1 B2:
83	    VWt γ1 Γ V (VSum A1 A2) ->
84	    CWt (q1 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A1 Γ) M1 B1 ->
85	    CWt (q2 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A2 Γ) M2 B2 ->
86	    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
87	    B = (down_compTy_until B1 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

Require Export strictness.cbpv.syntax.

Require Import Psatz.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Definition context n : Type := fin n -> ValTy n.

Definition ctx_insert {n} (A : ValTy n) (Γ : context n) : context (S n) :=
    (Lazy A↑ A) .: (fun fn => Lazy A↑ (Γ fn)).

Inductive VWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Val n -> ValTy n -> Prop :=
  | T_Var i A :
    A = Γ i ->
    γ = (lazyvector <- Strict @ i) ->

    VWt γ Γ (vVar i) A

  | T_Unit :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ vUnit VUnit

  | T_Thunk γ' M B :
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ (vThunk M) (VThunk γ' B)

  | T_Pair γ1 γ2 V1 V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V1 A1 ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V2 A2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vPair V1 V2) (VProd A1 A2)

  | T_Inl V1 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V1 A1 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInl V1) (VSum A1 A2)

  | T_Inr V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V2 A2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInr V2) (VSum A1 A2)

with CWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Comp n -> CompTy n -> Prop :=
  | T_Ret V A :
    VWt γ Γ V A ->

    CWt γ Γ (cRet V) (CF A)

  | T_Let q M M' A B B' γ1 γ2:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CF A) ->
    CWt (q .: γ2) (ctx_insert A Γ) M' B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cLet M M') B

  | T_Force V B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VThunk γ2 B) ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cForce V) B

  | T_Seq V M B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V VUnit ->
    CWt γ2 Γ M B ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSeq V M) B

  | T_Split q1 q2 V M γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B':
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VProd A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2)) (ctx_insert (Lazy A↑ A1) (ctx_insert A2 Γ)) M B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (le_succ_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSplit V M) B

  | T_Case q1 q2 V M1 M2 γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B1 B2:
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VSum A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A1 Γ) M1 B1 ->
    CWt (q2 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A2 Γ) M2 B2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B1 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B2 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cCase V M1 M2) B

  | T_Abs q M A B B' :
    CWt (q .: γ) (ctx_insert A Γ) M B' ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cAbs M) (CAbs q A B)

  | T_App M q V γ1 γ2 A B:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CAbs q A B) ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V A ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cApp M V) B

  | T_CSub M γ' B:
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ γ<= γ' ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSub M) B
.

Scheme VWt_ind' := Induction for VWt Sort Prop
    with CWt_ind' := Induction for CWt Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme Wt_mutual from VWt_ind', CWt_ind'.

Require Export strictness.common.attributes.

Require Export strictness.autosubst2.fintype.

Require Import Psatz.

From Coq Require Export PeanoNat.

From Coq Require Export Bool.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive Kind := ValFlag : Kind | CompFlag : Kind.

Inductive Ty (n : nat) : Kind -> Type :=
  | VUnit : Ty n ValFlag
  | VThunk (γ : attrs n) (B : Ty n CompFlag) : Ty n ValFlag
  | VProd (A1 : Ty n ValFlag) (A2 : Ty n ValFlag) : Ty n ValFlag
  | VSum (A1 : Ty n ValFlag ) (A2 : Ty n ValFlag) : Ty n ValFlag
  | CAbs (q : attr) (A : Ty n ValFlag) (B : Ty n CompFlag) : Ty n CompFlag
  | CF (A : Ty n ValFlag) : Ty n CompFlag
.

Definition ValTy n := Ty n ValFlag.

Definition CompTy n := Ty n CompFlag.

Arguments VUnit {n}.

Arguments VThunk {n}.

Arguments VProd {n}.

Arguments VSum {n}.

Arguments CF {n}.

Arguments CAbs {n}.

Fixpoint ren_ty {n m k} (ξ : fin m -> fin n) (T : Ty n k) : Ty m k :=
  match T with
  | VUnit => VUnit
  | VProd A1 A2 => VProd (ren_ty ξ A1) (ren_ty ξ A2)
  | VSum A1 A2 => VSum (ren_ty ξ A1) (ren_ty ξ A2)
  | VThunk γ B => VThunk (ren_env γ ξ) (ren_ty ξ B)
  | CF A => CF (ren_ty ξ A)
  | CAbs q A B => CAbs q (ren_ty ξ A) (ren_ty ξ B)
  end
.

Definition down_ty {n k} (T : Ty (S n) k) : Ty n k := ren_ty shift T.

Definition down_valTy {n} := @down_ty n ValFlag.

Definition down_compTy {n} := @down_ty n CompFlag.

Notation "'A↓' A" := (down_valTy A) (at level 85).

Notation "'B↓' B" := (down_compTy B) (at level 85).

Fixpoint map_Ty {n m k} (ξ : attrs n -> attrs m) (T : Ty n k) : Ty m k :=
  match T with
  | VUnit => VUnit
  | VThunk γ B => VThunk (ξ γ) (map_Ty ξ B)
  | VProd A1 A2 => VProd (map_Ty ξ A1) (map_Ty ξ A2)
  | VSum A1 A2 => VSum (map_Ty ξ A1) (map_Ty ξ A2)
  | CF A => CF (map_Ty ξ A)
  | CAbs q' A B => CAbs q' (map_Ty ξ A) (map_Ty ξ B)
  end
.

Definition up_Ty {n k} q (T : Ty n k) : Ty (S n) k := map_Ty (fun γ => q .: γ) T.

Definition up_valTy {n} := @up_Ty n ValFlag.

Definition up_compTy {n} := @up_Ty n CompFlag.

Infix "A↑" := (up_valTy) (at level 85).

Infix "B↑" := (up_compTy) (at level 85).

Fixpoint down_ty_until {n k} (A : Ty n k) m (H : m <= n) : Ty m k :=
  match A with
  | VUnit => VUnit
  | VProd A1 A2 => VProd (down_ty_until A1 m H) (down_ty_until A2 m H)
  | VSum A1 A2 => VSum (down_ty_until A1 m H) (down_ty_until A2 m H)
  | VThunk γ B => VThunk (down_env_until γ m H) (down_ty_until B m H)
  | CF A => CF (down_ty_until A m H)
  | CAbs q A B =>
    CAbs q (down_ty_until A m H) (down_ty_until B m H)
  end
.

Definition down_valTy_until {n} := @down_ty_until n ValFlag.

Definition down_compTy_until {n} := @down_ty_until n CompFlag.

Inductive Val (n : nat) : Type :=
  | vVar (x : fin n) : Val n


  | vUnit : Val n


  | vThunk (M : Comp n) : Val n


  | vPair (V1 :Val n) (V2: Val n) : Val n


  | vInl (V : Val n) : Val n
  | vInr (V : Val n) : Val n

 with Comp (n : nat) : Type :=

  | cRet (V : Val n) : Comp n

  | cLet (M : Comp n) (M' : Comp (S n)) : Comp n


  | cForce (V : Val n) : Comp n


  | cSeq (V : Val n) (M : Comp n) : Comp n


  | cAbs (M : Comp (S n)) : Comp n

  | cApp (M : Comp n) (V : Val n) : Comp n


  | cSplit (V : Val n) (M : Comp (S (S (n)))) : Comp n


  | cCase (V : Val n) (M1 : Comp (S n)) (M2 : Comp (S n)) : Comp n


  | cSub (V : Comp n) : Comp n
.

Arguments vVar {n}.

Arguments vUnit {n}.

Arguments vThunk {n}.

Arguments vPair {n}.

Arguments vInl {n}.

Arguments vInr {n}.

Arguments cRet {n}.

Arguments cLet {n}.

Arguments cForce {n}.

Arguments cSeq {n}.

Arguments cAbs {n}.

Arguments cApp {n}.

Arguments cSplit {n}.

Arguments cCase {n}.

Arguments cSub {n}.

Scheme Val_ind' := Induction for Val Sort Prop
    with Comp_ind' := Induction for Comp Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme ValComp_mutual from Val_ind', Comp_ind'.

Definition upRen_Val_Val { m n : nat } (ξ : fin m -> fin n) : fin (S m) -> fin (S n) :=
  up_ren ξ.

Fixpoint ren_Val { m n } (ξ : fin m -> fin n) (s : Val m) : Val n :=
    match s return Val n with
    | vVar s => vVar (ξ s)
    | vUnit => vUnit
    | vThunk s0 => vThunk (ren_Comp ξ s0)
    | vPair s0 s1 => vPair (ren_Val ξ s0) (ren_Val ξ s1)
    | vInl s0 => vInl (ren_Val ξ s0)
    | vInr s0 => vInr (ren_Val ξ s0)
    end
 with ren_Comp { m n } (ξ : fin m -> fin n) (s : Comp m) : Comp n :=
    match s return Comp n with
    | cAbs s1 => cAbs (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s1)
    | cApp s0 s1 => cApp (ren_Comp ξ s0) (ren_Val ξ s1)
    | cForce s0 => cForce (ren_Val ξ s0)
    | cSplit s1 s2 => cSplit (ren_Val ξ s1)
      (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val (upRen_Val_Val ξ)) s2)
    | cRet s1 => cRet (ren_Val ξ s1)
    | cLet s1 s2 => cLet (ren_Comp ξ s1) (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s2)
    | cSeq s0 s1 => cSeq (ren_Val ξ s0) (ren_Comp ξ s1)
    | cCase s1 s2 s3 => cCase (ren_Val ξ s1)
        (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s2)
        (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s3)
    | cSub s1 => cSub (ren_Comp ξ s1)
    end.

13	Inductive Clos : Kind ->  Type :=
14	| Absent : Clos ValFlag
15	| Unit : Clos ValFlag
16	| Thunk (mOuter : nat) mInner (γ' : attrs mOuter)  (ρ : fin mInner -> Clos ValFlag) (M : Comp mInner) : Clos ValFlag
17	| Pair (W1 W2 : Clos ValFlag) : Clos ValFlag
18	| Inl (W : Clos ValFlag) : Clos ValFlag
19	| Inr (W : Clos ValFlag) : Clos ValFlag
20	| Return (W : Clos ValFlag) : Clos CompFlag
21	| Closure (mOuter : nat) mInner (γ' : attrs mOuter) (ρ : fin mInner -> Clos ValFlag) (M : Comp (S mInner)) : Clos CompFlag.
22	
23	Definition ClosValue := Clos ValFlag.
24	
25	Definition ClosComp := Clos CompFlag.
26	
27	Definition env n := fin n -> ClosValue.
28	
29	Definition min_le : forall m n, min m n <= m := ltac:(lia).
30	
31	Fixpoint down_clos {k} scope (C : Clos k) : Clos k :=
32	  match C with
33	  | Absent => Absent
34	  | Unit => Unit
35	  | Thunk n m γ' ρ M => Thunk (min n scope) m (down_env_until γ' (min n scope) (min_le n scope)) ρ M
36	  | Pair W1 W2 => Pair (down_clos scope W1) (down_clos scope W2)
37	  | Inl W => Inl (down_clos scope W)
38	  | Inr W => Inr (down_clos scope W)
39	  | Return W => Return (down_clos scope W)
40	  | Closure n m γ' ρ M => Closure (min n scope) m (down_env_until γ' (min n scope) (min_le n scope)) ρ M
41	  end.
42	
43	Definition down_value := @down_clos ValFlag.
44	
45	Definition down_comp := @down_clos CompFlag.
46	
47	Notation "scope 'W↓' W" := (down_value scope W) (at level 85).
48	
49	Notation "scope 'T↓' T" := (down_comp scope T) (at level 85).
50	
51	Fixpoint well_scoped_clos {k} (C : Clos k) max_scope :=
52	  match C with
53	  | Absent => True
54	  | Unit => True
55	  | Thunk n m γ ρ M => n <= max_scope
56	  | Pair W1 W2 => well_scoped_clos W1 max_scope /\ well_scoped_clos W2 max_scope
57	  | Inl W => well_scoped_clos W max_scope
58	  | Inr W => well_scoped_clos W max_scope
59	  | Return W => well_scoped_clos W max_scope
60	  | Closure n _ _ ρ _  => n <= max_scope
61	end.
62	
63	Definition well_scoped_value := @well_scoped_clos ValFlag.
64	
65	Definition well_scoped_env {n} (ρ : env n) m := forall i, well_scoped_value (ρ i) m.
66	
67	Definition well_scoped_comp := @well_scoped_clos CompFlag.
68	
69	Inductive EvalVal {n} (γ : attrs n) (ρ : env n) : Val n -> ClosValue -> Prop :=
70	  | E_Var i W :
71	    W = ρ i ->
72	    γ = (lazyvector <- Strict @ i) ->
73	    W <> Absent ->
74	
75	    EvalVal γ ρ (vVar i) W
76	
77	  | E_Unit :
78	    γ = lazyvector ->
79	
80	    EvalVal γ ρ vUnit Unit
81	
82	  | E_Thunk M γ' :
83	    γ = lazyvector ->
84	
85	    EvalVal γ ρ (vThunk M) (Thunk n n γ' ρ M)

Require Export strictness.cbpv.syntax strictness.cbpv.typing.

From Coq Require Export PeanoNat.

From Coq Require Export Bool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Require Import Psatz.

Inductive Clos : Kind ->  Type :=
| Absent : Clos ValFlag
| Unit : Clos ValFlag
| Thunk (mOuter : nat) mInner (γ' : attrs mOuter)  (ρ : fin mInner -> Clos ValFlag) (M : Comp mInner) : Clos ValFlag
| Pair (W1 W2 : Clos ValFlag) : Clos ValFlag
| Inl (W : Clos ValFlag) : Clos ValFlag
| Inr (W : Clos ValFlag) : Clos ValFlag
| Return (W : Clos ValFlag) : Clos CompFlag
| Closure (mOuter : nat) mInner (γ' : attrs mOuter) (ρ : fin mInner -> Clos ValFlag) (M : Comp (S mInner)) : Clos CompFlag.

Definition ClosValue := Clos ValFlag.

Definition ClosComp := Clos CompFlag.

Definition env n := fin n -> ClosValue.

Definition min_le : forall m n, min m n <= m := ltac:(lia).

Fixpoint down_clos {k} scope (C : Clos k) : Clos k :=
  match C with
  | Absent => Absent
  | Unit => Unit
  | Thunk n m γ' ρ M => Thunk (min n scope) m (down_env_until γ' (min n scope) (min_le n scope)) ρ M
  | Pair W1 W2 => Pair (down_clos scope W1) (down_clos scope W2)
  | Inl W => Inl (down_clos scope W)
  | Inr W => Inr (down_clos scope W)
  | Return W => Return (down_clos scope W)
  | Closure n m γ' ρ M => Closure (min n scope) m (down_env_until γ' (min n scope) (min_le n scope)) ρ M
  end.

Definition down_value := @down_clos ValFlag.

Definition down_comp := @down_clos CompFlag.

Notation "scope 'W↓' W" := (down_value scope W) (at level 85).

Notation "scope 'T↓' T" := (down_comp scope T) (at level 85).

Fixpoint well_scoped_clos {k} (C : Clos k) max_scope :=
  match C with
  | Absent => True
  | Unit => True
  | Thunk n m γ ρ M => n <= max_scope
  | Pair W1 W2 => well_scoped_clos W1 max_scope /\ well_scoped_clos W2 max_scope
  | Inl W => well_scoped_clos W max_scope
  | Inr W => well_scoped_clos W max_scope
  | Return W => well_scoped_clos W max_scope
  | Closure n _ _ ρ _  => n <= max_scope
end.

Definition well_scoped_value := @well_scoped_clos ValFlag.

Definition well_scoped_env {n} (ρ : env n) m := forall i, well_scoped_value (ρ i) m.

Definition well_scoped_comp := @well_scoped_clos CompFlag.

Inductive EvalVal {n} (γ : attrs n) (ρ : env n) : Val n -> ClosValue -> Prop :=
  | E_Var i W :
    W = ρ i ->
    γ = (lazyvector <- Strict @ i) ->
    W <> Absent ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vVar i) W

  | E_Unit :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    EvalVal γ ρ vUnit Unit

  | E_Thunk M γ' :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vThunk M) (Thunk n n γ' ρ M)

  | E_VPair γ1 γ2 V1 V2 W1 W2 :
    EvalVal γ1 ρ V1 W1 ->
    EvalVal γ2 ρ V2 W2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vPair V1 V2) (Pair W1 W2)

  | E_Inl V W :
    EvalVal γ ρ V W ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vInl V) (Inl W)

  | E_Inr V W :
    EvalVal γ ρ V W ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vInr V) (Inr W)
.

Inductive EvalComp {n} (γ : attrs n) (ρ : env n) : Comp n -> ClosComp -> Prop :=
| E_Abs M :

  EvalComp γ ρ (cAbs M) (Closure n n γ ρ M)

| E_AppAbs n' m q γ1 γ2 γ' γUp H M M' V T T' W ρ':
  EvalComp γ1 ρ M (Closure n' m γ' ρ' M') ->
  EvalVal γ2 ρ V W ->
  γ' = down_env_until γUp n' H ->
  EvalComp (q .: γUp) ((n' W↓ W) .: ρ') M' T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n' T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cApp M V) T

| E_Split q1 q2 γ1 γ2 V N W1 W2 T T' :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V (Pair W1 W2) ->
  EvalComp (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2)) (W1 .: (W2 .: ρ)) N T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cSplit V N) T

| E_Ret V W :
  EvalVal γ ρ V W ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cRet V) (Return W)

| E_LetRet γ1 γ2 q M N W T T' :
  EvalComp γ1 ρ M (Return W) ->
  EvalComp (q .: γ2) (W .: ρ) N T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cLet M N) T

| E_Force mInner mOuter (γ2'' : attrs n) γ1 (γ2 : attrs mOuter) γ2' V M T T' ρ' Hn HInner :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V (Thunk mOuter mInner γ2 ρ' M) ->
  EvalComp γ2' ρ' M T' ->
  down_env_until γ2' mOuter HInner = γ2 ->
  down_env_until γ2'' mOuter Hn = γ2 ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2'' ->
  T = (mOuter T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cForce V) T

| E_Seq γ1 γ2 V N T :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V Unit ->
  EvalComp γ2 ρ N T ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cSeq V N) T

| E_Casel γ1 γ2 q V M1 M2 W T T' :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V (Inl W) ->
  EvalComp (q .: γ2) (W .: ρ) M1 T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cCase V M1 M2) T

| E_Caser γ1 γ2 q V M1 M2 W T T' :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V (Inr W) ->
  EvalComp (q .: γ2) (W .: ρ) M2 T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cCase V M1 M2) T

| E_CSub M γ' B:
  EvalComp γ' ρ M B ->
  γ γ<= γ' ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cSub M) B
.

Inductive eq_up_to_attrs : forall (k : Kind), Clos k -> Clos k -> Prop :=
  | Eq_Absent : eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag Absent Absent
  | Eq_Unit : eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag Unit Unit
  | Eq_Thunk n m γ γ' ρ ρ' M :
    (forall i, eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (ρ i) (ρ' i)) ->
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (Thunk n m γ ρ M) (Thunk n m γ' ρ' M)

  | Eq_Pair W1 W2 W1' W2' :
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W1 W1' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W2 W2' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (Pair W1 W2) (Pair W1' W2')

  | Eq_Inl W W' :
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W W' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (Inl W) (Inl W')

  | Eq_Inr W W' :
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W W' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (Inr W) (Inr W')

  | Eq_Return W W' :
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W W' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs CompFlag (Return W) (Return W')

  | Eq_Closure n m γ γ' ρ ρ' M :
    (forall i, eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (ρ i) (ρ' i)) ->
    eq_up_to_attrs CompFlag (Closure n m γ ρ M) (Closure n m γ' ρ' M)
.

Arguments eq_up_to_attrs {k}.

Definition eq_env_up_to_attrs {n} (ρ1 ρ2 : env n) :=
  forall i, eq_up_to_attrs (ρ1 i) (ρ2 i).

Definition EvalValFail {n} (ρ : env n) V :=
  forall γ W ρ', eq_env_up_to_attrs ρ ρ' -> ~ EvalVal γ ρ' V W.

Definition EvalCompFail {n} (ρ : env n) M :=
  forall γ T ρ', eq_env_up_to_attrs ρ ρ' -> ~ EvalComp γ ρ' M T.

 let H0 : m = m - n + n := le_minus_plus n m H in
 let fn1 := eq_rec_r (fun n0 : nat => fin n0) fn0 H0 in fn1)
:
ren n m.

Definition down_env_until' {A m} k (γ : fin (k + m) -> A) : fin m -> A :=
    ren_env γ (shift_p k).

Definition down_env_until : forall {A : Type} {n : nat},
       (fin n -> A) -> forall m : nat, m <= n -> fin m -> A :=
fun (A : Type) (n : nat) (γ : fin n -> A) (m : nat) (H : m <= n) =>
let H0 : n - m + m = n :=
  let H0 : n = n - m + m := le_minus_plus m n H in eq_sym H0 in
let γ0 := eq_rect_r (fun n0 : nat => fin n0 -> A) γ H0 in
down_env_until' (n - m) γ0.
Arguments down_env_until {A} {n} 
  γ m H _.

Definition pad_with' : forall {n : nat}, attr -> attrs n -> forall k : nat, attrs (k + n) :=
fun (n : nat) (q : attr) (γ : attrs n) (k : nat) =>
nat_rect (fun k0 : nat => attrs (k0 + n)) (γ : attrs (0 + n))
  (fun (k0 : nat) (IHk : attrs (k0 + n)) =>
   let H : S (k0 + n) = S k0 + n := eq_refl in
   eq_rect (S (k0 + n)) (fun n0 : nat => attrs n0)
     ((fun i : fin (S (k0 + n)) =>
       match i with
       | Some f => (fun f0 : fin (k0 + n) => IHk f0) f
       | None => q
       end)
      :
      attrs (S (k0 + n)))
     (S k0 + n) H)
  k.
Arguments pad_with' {n} q γ k _.

Definition pad_with : forall {n : nat}, attr -> attrs n -> forall m : nat, n <= m -> attrs m :=
fun (n : nat) (q : attr) (γ : attrs n) (m : nat) (H : n <= m) =>
let γPad := pad_with' q γ (m - n) in
let HeqγPad : γPad = pad_with' q γ (m - n) := eq_refl in
let H0 : m = m - n + n := le_minus_plus n m H in
let γPad0 := eq_rect_r (fun n0 : nat => attrs n0) γPad H0 in γPad0.

Definition fin_to_nat : forall {n : nat}, fin (S n) -> nat :=
fix fin_to_nat (n : nat) (f : fin (S n)) {struct n} : nat :=
  match f with
  | Some f0 =>
      (fun f1 : fin n =>
       match n as n0 return (fin n0 -> nat) with
       | 0 => fun f2 : fin 0 => False_rec nat f2
       | S n0 =>
           (fun (n1 : nat) (f2 : fin (S n1)) => S (fin_to_nat n1 f2)) n0
       end f1) f0

  end.

Require Export strictness.autosubst2.fintype.

Definition fin_eqb : forall {n : nat}, fin n -> fin n -> bool :=
fun n : nat =>
nat_rec (fun n0 : nat => fin n0 -> fin n0 -> bool)
  (fun _ H : fin 0 => False_rec bool H)
  (fun (n0 : nat) (IHn : fin n0 -> fin n0 -> bool) (i1 i2 : fin (S n0)) =>
   let f := i1 in
   let H1 : i1 = f := eq_refl in
   match f as o return (i1 = o -> bool) with
   | Some f0 =>
       (fun
          (i1' : (fix fin (n1 : nat) : Set :=
                    match n1 with
                    | 0 => False
                    | S m => option (fin m)
                    end)
                   n0)
          (_ : i1 = Some i1') =>
        let f1 := i2 in
        let H2 : i2 = f1 := eq_refl in
        match f1 as o return (i2 = o -> bool) with
        | Some f2 =>
            (fun
               (i2' : (fix fin (n1 : nat) : Set :=
                         match n1 with
                         | 0 => False
                         | S m => option (fin m)
                         end)
                        n0)
               (_ : i2 = Some i2') =>
             let b := IHn i1' i2' in
             let IHe : IHn i1' i2' = b := eq_refl in
             (if b as b0 return (IHn i1' i2' = b0 -> bool)
              then fun _ : IHn i1' i2' = true => true
              else fun _ : IHn i1' i2' = false => false) IHe) f2
        | None => fun _ : i2 = None => false
        end H2) f0
   | None =>
       fun _ : i1 = None =>
       let f0 := i2 in
       let H2 : i2 = f0 := eq_refl in
       match f0 as o return (i2 = o -> bool) with
       | Some f1 =>
           (fun
              (i2' : (fix fin (n1 : nat) : Set :=
                        match n1 with
                        | 0 => False
                        | S m => option (fin m)
                        end)
                       n0)
              (_ : i2 = Some i2') =>
            false) f1
       | None => fun _ : i2 = None => true
       end H2
   end H1)
  n.
Arguments fin_eqb {n} _ _.

Definition up_ren' {n} : ren (S n) (S (S n)) := (var_zero .: shift >> shift).

Definition up2_ren' {n} : ren (S (S n)) (S (S (S n))) := (var_zero .: (shift (var_zero) .: shift >> shift >> shift)).

Definition ren_inj {n m} (renamer : ren n m) :=
    (forall i1 i2, renamer i1 = renamer i2 -> i1 = i2).

Definition ren_match {n m X} (renamer : ren n m)
    (fn : fin n -> X) (fm : fin m -> X) :=
    forall i, fn i = fm (renamer i).

Definition default_or_preimage {n m X} (id : X) (fm : fin m -> X) (renamer : ren n m) :=
    (forall j, fm j = id \/ exists i, j = renamer i).

Inductive ren_preimage_cases {n m} (renamer : ren n m) (j : fin m) : Type :=
    | preimage (i : fin n) (H : j = renamer i) : ren_preimage_cases renamer j
    | no_preimage (H : forall (i : fin n), renamer i <> j) : ren_preimage_cases renamer j
    .

Definition env_map {n}{A B} (f : A -> B) (ρ : fin n -> A) : fin n -> B :=
  fun x => f (ρ (x)).

Require Export strictness.autosubst2.axioms.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Unset Strict Implicit.

Definition ap {X Y} (f : X -> Y) {x y : X} (p : x = y) : f x = f y :=
  match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end.

Definition apc {X Y} {f g : X -> Y} {x y : X} (p : f = g) (q : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Fixpoint fin (n : nat) : Set :=
  match n with
  | 0 => False
  | S m => option (fin m)
  end.

Definition ren (m n : nat) : Type := fin m -> fin n.

Definition id {X} (x : X) := x.

Definition idren {k: nat} : ren k k :=
  fun x => x.

Definition var_zero {n : nat} : fin (S n) := None.

Definition null {T} (i : fin 0) : T := match i with end.

Definition shift {n : nat} : ren n (S n) :=
  Some.

Definition comp := @funcomp.

Definition scons {X : Type} {n : nat} (x : X) (f : fin n -> X) (m : fin (S n)) : X :=
  match m with
  | None => x
  | Some i => f i
  end.

Class Ren1 (X1  : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren3 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren4 (X1 X2 X3 X4 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren4 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren5 (X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren5 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> X5 -> Y -> Z.

Declare Scope fscope.

Declare Scope subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ⟩" := (ren1  xi1 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ⟩" := (ren3 xi1 xi2 xi3 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ⟩" := (ren4  xi1 xi2 xi3 xi4 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ; xi5 ⟩" := (ren5  xi1 xi2 xi3 xi4 xi5 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ; xi5 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "⟨ xi ⟩" := (ren1 xi) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi ⟩") : fscope.

Notation "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : fscope.

Class Subst1 (X1 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Subst2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y  -> Z.

Class Subst3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst3 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 ->  Y  -> Z.

Class Subst4 (X1 X2 X3 X4: Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst4 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> Y  -> Z.

Class Subst5 (X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst5 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> X5  -> Y  -> Z.

Notation "s [ sigma ]" := (subst1 sigma s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ]") : subst_scope.

Notation "s [ sigma ; tau ]" := (subst2 sigma tau s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ; '/'  tau ]") : subst_scope.

Class Var X Y :=
  ids : X -> Y.

Arguments funcomp {X Y Z} (g) (f).

Notation "f >> g" := (funcomp g f) (at level 50).

Open Scope subst_scope.

Notation "x .: f" := (@scons _ _ x f) (at level 55) : subst_scope.

Definition up_ren m n (xi : ren m n) : ren (S m) (S n) :=
  var_zero .: xi >> shift.

Fixpoint shift_p (p : nat) {n} : ren n (p + n) :=
  fun n => match p with
        | 0 => n
        | S p => Some (shift_p p n)
        end.

Definition scons_p : forall {X : Type} (m : nat) {n : nat},
       (fin m -> X) -> (fin n -> X) -> fin (m + n) -> X :=
fix scons_p (X : Type) (m : nat) {struct m} :
    forall n : nat, (fin m -> X) -> (fin n -> X) -> fin (m + n) -> X :=
  match
    m as n
    return
      (forall n0 : nat, (fin n -> X) -> (fin n0 -> X) -> fin (n + n0) -> X)
  with
  | 0 => fun (n : nat) (_ : fin 0 -> X) (g : fin n -> X) => g
  | S n =>
      (fun (m0 n0 : nat) (f : fin (S m0) -> X) (g : fin n0 -> X) =>
       f var_zero .: scons_p X m0 n0 (fun z : fin m0 => f (Some z)) g
       :
       fin (S m0 + n0) -> X) n
  end.
Arguments scons_p {X} m {n}
  (f g) _.

Definition zero_p : forall (m : nat) {n : nat}, fin m -> fin (m + n) :=
fun m n : nat =>
nat_rec (fun m0 : nat => fin m0 -> fin (m0 + n))
  (fun H : fin 0 => match H return (fin (0 + n)) with
                    end)
  (fun (m0 : nat) (IHm : fin m0 -> fin (m0 + n)) (H : fin (S m0)) =>
   match H with
   | Some f => (fun x : fin m0 => shift_p 1 (IHm x)) f
   | None => var_zero
   end)

From strictness.cbpv Require Import strict_semtyping.
From Stdlib Require Import Eqdep_dec Arith.Peano_dec.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Set Printing Implicit.

Lemma eq_rect_r_app : forall {A} {n k} (e : n = k) (f : fin n -> A) (a : fin k),
  eq_rect_r (fun n0 => fin n0 -> A) f (eq_sym e) a = f (eq_rec_r (fun n0 => fin n0) a e).
Proof. intros. destruct e. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma down_env_until_up : forall {A n} (γ : fin n -> A) m (H : m <= n) (i : fin m),
  down_env_until γ m H i = γ (up_fin_until n H i).
Proof.
  intros. unfold down_env_until, up_fin_until, down_env_until', ren_env.
  cbn. apply eq_rect_r_app.
Qed.

Lemma eq_rec_r_self : forall {n} (Q : nat -> Set) (a : Q n) (e : n = n),
  eq_rec_r Q a e = a.
Proof. intros. dependent destruction e. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma up_fin_until_self : forall n (H : n <= n) x, up_fin_until n H x = x.
Proof.
  intros n. induction n as [|n IH]; intros H x.
  - destruct x.
  - destruct x as [x|].
    all: unfold up_fin_until.
    all: assert (Hs : S n - S n = 0) by apply Nat.sub_diag.
    all: generalize (le_minus_plus (S n) (S n) H).
    all: rewrite Hs.
    all: cbn.
    all: intros e.
    all: rewrite (eq_rec_r_self (fun n0 => fin n0) _ e).
    all: reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma down_env_until_self : forall {A n} (γ : fin n -> A) (H : n <= n) x,
  down_env_until γ n H x = γ x.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite down_env_until_up. rewrite up_fin_until_self. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* attribute lemmas *)
Lemma attr_add_strict_l : forall a b, a C+ b = Strict -> a = Strict \/ b = Strict.
Proof. intros a b. destruct a, b; cbn; try discriminate; auto. Qed.

Lemma attr_stricter_strict : forall a b, a S<= b -> b = Strict -> a = Strict.
Proof. intros a b H. destruct a, b; cbn in *; try discriminate; auto; try (destruct H). Qed.

Lemma attr_le_strict : forall a b, a C<= b -> a = Strict -> b = Strict.
Proof. intros a b H. destruct a,b; cbn in *; try discriminate; auto; try contradiction. Qed.

(* distribution of down_env_until over gamma+ *)
Lemma down_env_until_add : forall {n} (γ1 γ2 : attrs n) m (H : m <= n) (i : fin m),
  down_env_until (γ1 γ+ γ2) m H i = (down_env_until γ1 m H i) C+ (down_env_until γ2 m H i).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite !down_env_until_up. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* LR shift *)
Lemma up_Ty_VUnit : forall {n} q, @up_Ty n ValFlag q VUnit = VUnit.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma LR_shift : forall {n k} q (A : Ty n k) C mLower (x : fin mLower),
  LR_maybe A C mLower x -> LR_maybe (up_Ty q A) C mLower x.
Proof.
  intros n k q A. induction A; intros C mLower x H.
  - (* VUnit *) cbn in *. exact H.
  - (* VThunk *) cbn in *. 
    destruct H as (mOuter & mInner & γScoped & γInner & ρ & M & HInner & Hn & HLower & Hnlower & Hd1 & Hd2 & HC & HLRM).
    cbn. exists mOuter, mInner, γScoped, γInner, ρ, M, HInner.
    (* need Hn' : mOuter <= S n *)
    exists (Nat.le_trans Hn (Nat.le_succ n)), HLower, Hnlower.
    split; [ | split; [ | split ]].
    + (* down (q.:γ) mOuter = γScoped *)
Abort.
EOF

From strictness.cbpv Require Import strict_semtyping.
From Stdlib Require Import Eqdep_dec Arith.Peano_dec.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Set Printing Implicit.

Fixpoint f2n (n : nat) : fin n -> nat :=
  match n as n0 return (fin n0 -> nat) with
  | 0 => fun x => match x with end
  | S m => fun x => match x with
                    | None => 0
                    | Some y => S (f2n m y)
                    end
  end.

Lemma f2n_shift : forall p {n} (i : fin n), f2n (p+n) (shift_p p i) = p + f2n n i.
Proof.
  intros p. induction p as [|p IH]; intros n i.
  - cbn. rewrite Nat.add_0_l. reflexivity.
  - cbn. rewrite IH. rewrite Nat.add_succ_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma f2n_transport : forall {n k} (e : n = k) (x : fin k),
  f2n n (@eq_rec_r nat k (fun j => fin j) x n e) = f2n k x.
Proof. intros. destruct e. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma f2n_inj : forall {n} (x y : fin n), f2n n x = f2n n y -> x = y.
Proof.
  intros n. induction n as [|n IH]; intros x y H.
  - destruct x.
  - destruct x as [x|], y as [y|]; cbn in *.
    + f_equal. apply IH. injection H. auto.
    + discriminate.
    + discriminate.
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma up_fin_until_comp : forall {a} b c (H1 : a <= b) (H2 : b <= c) (i : fin a),
  up_fin_until c H2 (up_fin_until b H1 i) = up_fin_until c (Nat.le_trans H1 H2) i.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2 i.
  apply f2n_inj.
  unfold up_fin_until.
  rewrite f2n_transport. rewrite f2n_shift.
  rewrite f2n_transport. rewrite f2n_shift.
  rewrite f2n_transport. rewrite f2n_shift.
  assert (Hsub : (c - b) + (b - a) = c - a) by lia.
  rewrite Nat.add_assoc. rewrite Hsub. reflexivity.

Lemma eq_rect_r_app : forall {A} {n k} (e : n = k) (f : fin n -> A) (a : fin k),
  eq_rect_r (fun n0 => fin n0 -> A) f (eq_sym e) a = f (eq_rec_r (fun n0 => fin n0) a e).
Proof. intros. destruct e. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma down_env_until_up : forall {A n} (γ : fin n -> A) m (H : m <= n) (i : fin m),
  down_env_until γ m H i = γ (up_fin_until n H i).
Proof. intros. unfold down_env_until, up_fin_until, down_env_until', ren_env. cbn. apply eq_rect_r_app. Qed.

Lemma eq_rec_r_fin_Some : forall {n k} (e : n = k) (y : fin k),
  @eq_rec_r nat (S k) (fun j => fin j) (Some y) (S n) (f_equal S e)
   = Some (@eq_rec_r nat k (fun j => fin j) y n e).
Proof. intros. destruct e. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma eq_rec_r_self : forall {n} (Q : nat -> Set) (a : Q n) (e : n = n),
  eq_rec_r Q a e = a.
Proof. intros. dependent destruction e. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma up_fin_until_self : forall n (H : n <= n) x, @up_fin_until n n H x = x.
Proof.
  intros n. induction n as [|n IH]; intros H x.
  - destruct x.
  - destruct x as [x|].
    all: unfold up_fin_until.
    all: assert (Hs : S n - S n = 0) by apply Nat.sub_diag.
    all: generalize (le_minus_plus (S n) (S n) H).
    all: rewrite Hs.
    all: cbn.
    all: intros e.
    all: rewrite (eq_rec_r_self (fun n0 => fin n0) _ e).
    all: reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma down_env_until_self : forall {A n} (γ : fin n -> A) (H : n <= n) x,
  down_env_until γ n H x = γ x.
Proof. intros. rewrite down_env_until_up. rewrite up_fin_until_self. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma down_env_self_fun : forall {A n} (γ : fin n -> A) (H : n <= n), down_env_until γ n H = γ.
Proof. intros. apply functional_extensionality. intro i. apply down_env_until_self. Qed.

Lemma up_fin_until_succ : forall {n} m (H : m <= n) (H' : m <= S n) (i : fin m),
  @up_fin_until m (S n) H' i = Some (@up_fin_until m n H i).
Proof.
  intros n m H H' i.
  unfold up_fin_until.
  generalize (le_minus_plus m (S n) H') as e1.
  generalize (le_minus_plus m n H) as e2.

Proof. intros. rewrite !down_env_until_up. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma attr_add_strict_l : forall a b, a C+ b = Strict -> a = Strict \/ b = Strict.
Proof. intros a b. destruct a, b; cbn; try discriminate; auto. Qed.

Lemma attr_le_strict : forall a b, a C<= b -> a = Strict -> b = Strict.
Proof. intros a b H. destruct a,b; cbn in *; try discriminate; auto; try contradiction. Qed.

Fixpoint f2n (n : nat) : fin n -> nat :=
  match n as n0 return (fin n0 -> nat) with
  | 0 => fun x => match x with end
  | S m => fun x => match x with None => 0 | Some y => S (f2n m y) end
  end.

Qed.

Ty_ind
     : forall (n : nat) (P : forall k : Kind, Ty n k -> Prop),
       P ValFlag VUnit ->
       (forall (γ : attrs n) (B : Ty n CompFlag),
        P CompFlag B -> P ValFlag (VThunk γ B)) ->
       (forall A1 : Ty n ValFlag,
        P ValFlag A1 ->
        forall A2 : Ty n ValFlag, P ValFlag A2 -> P ValFlag (VProd A1 A2)) ->
       (forall A1 : Ty n ValFlag,
        P ValFlag A1 ->
        forall A2 : Ty n ValFlag, P ValFlag A2 -> P ValFlag (VSum A1 A2)) ->
       (forall (q : attr) (A : Ty n ValFlag),
        P ValFlag A ->
        forall B : Ty n CompFlag, P CompFlag B -> P CompFlag (CAbs q A B)) ->
       (forall A : Ty n ValFlag, P ValFlag A -> P CompFlag (CF A)) ->
       forall (k : Kind) (t : Ty n k), P k t
Ty_ind =
fun (n : nat) (P : forall k : Kind, Ty n k -> Prop) 
  (f : P ValFlag VUnit)
  (f0 : forall (γ : attrs n) (B : Ty n CompFlag),
        P CompFlag B -> P ValFlag (VThunk γ B))
  (f1 : forall A1 : Ty n ValFlag,
        P ValFlag A1 ->
        forall A2 : Ty n ValFlag, P ValFlag A2 -> P ValFlag (VProd A1 A2))
  (f2 : forall A1 : Ty n ValFlag,
        P ValFlag A1 ->
        forall A2 : Ty n ValFlag, P ValFlag A2 -> P ValFlag (VSum A1 A2))
  (f3 : forall (q : attr) (A : Ty n ValFlag),
        P ValFlag A ->
        forall B : Ty n CompFlag, P CompFlag B -> P CompFlag (CAbs q A B))
  (f4 : forall A : Ty n ValFlag, P ValFlag A -> P CompFlag (CF A)) =>
fix F (k : Kind) (t : Ty n k) {struct t} : P k t :=
  match t as t0 in (Ty _ k0) return (P k0 t0) with
  | VUnit => f
  | VThunk γ B => f0 γ B (F CompFlag B)
  | VProd A1 A2 => f1 A1 (F ValFlag A1) A2 (F ValFlag A2)
  | VSum A1 A2 => f2 A1 (F ValFlag A1) A2 (F ValFlag A2)
  | CAbs q A B => f3 q A (F ValFlag A) B (F CompFlag B)
  | CF A => f4 A (F ValFlag A)
  end
     : forall (n : nat) (P : forall k : Kind, Ty n k -> Prop),
       P ValFlag VUnit ->
       (forall (γ : attrs n) (B : Ty n CompFlag),
        P CompFlag B -> P ValFlag (VThunk γ B)) ->
       (forall A1 : Ty n ValFlag,
        P ValFlag A1 ->
        forall A2 : Ty n ValFlag, P ValFlag A2 -> P ValFlag (VProd A1 A2)) ->
       (forall A1 : Ty n ValFlag,
        P ValFlag A1 ->
        forall A2 : Ty n ValFlag, P ValFlag A2 -> P ValFlag (VSum A1 A2)) ->
       (forall (q : attr) (A : Ty n ValFlag),
        P ValFlag A ->
        forall B : Ty n CompFlag, P CompFlag B -> P CompFlag (CAbs q A B)) ->
       (forall A : Ty n ValFlag, P ValFlag A -> P CompFlag (CF A)) ->
       forall (k : Kind) (t : Ty n k), P k t

Lemma eq_rec_r_self : forall {n} (Q : nat -> Set) (a : Q n) (e : n = n), eq_rec_r Q a e = a.

Lemma up_fin_until_self : forall n (H : n <= n) x, @up_fin_until n n H x = x.

(* ===== logical-relation weakening infrastructure ===== *)

Lemma non_func_up : forall {n} q (B : Ty n CompFlag), non_func (up_Ty q B) <-> non_func B.
Proof.
  intros n q B. dependent destruction B; cbn; unfold non_func.
  - split; intros H; exfalso;
      [ apply (H q0 (map_Ty (fun γ => q .: γ) B1) (map_Ty (fun γ => q .: γ) B2))
      | apply (H q0 B1 B2) ]; reflexivity.
  - split; intros H q1 A1 B1 E; discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma LRM_up : forall {n} q (B : Ty n CompFlag) mInner (γ : attrs mInner) mO mLower (x : fin mLower)
  (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner) (ρ : env mInner) (M : Comp mInner),
  (forall C, LR_maybe B C mLower x -> LR_maybe (up_Ty q B) C mLower x) ->
  (forall C, LR_no B C mLower x -> LR_no (up_Ty q B) C mLower x) ->
  LRM B LR_maybe LR_no mInner γ mO mLower x Hnlower ρ M ->
  LRM (up_Ty q B) LR_maybe LR_no mInner γ mO mLower x Hnlower ρ M.
Proof.
  intros n q B mInner γ mO mLower x Hnlower ρ M Hmay Hno HLRM.
  unfold LRM in *. destruct HLRM as [H1 H2]. split.
  - intro Hstrict. destruct (H1 Hstrict) as [E1 E2]. split.
    + intro bnf. apply E1. apply (proj1 (non_func_up q B)). exact bnf.
    + intro nb.
      destruct (E2 (fun h => nb (proj2 (non_func_up q B) h))) as [f | (T & ev & lr)].
      * left; exact f.
      * right. exists T. split; [exact ev | apply Hno; exact lr].
  - intro Hns. destruct (H2 Hns) as [f | (T & ev & lr)].
    + left; exact f.
    + right. exists T. split; [exact ev | apply Hmay; exact lr].
Qed.

Lemma LRM_down : forall {n} (B : Ty n CompFlag) mInner (γ : attrs mInner) mO mO' mLower (x : fin mLower)
  (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner) (ρ : env mInner) (M : Comp mInner),
  mLower <= mO' -> mO' <= mO ->
  (forall C, LR_no B C mLower x -> LR_no B (down_clos mO' C) mLower x) ->
  (forall C, LR_maybe B C mLower x -> LR_maybe B (down_clos mO' C) mLower x) ->
  LRM B LR_maybe LR_no mInner γ mO mLower x Hnlower ρ M ->
  LRM B LR_maybe LR_no mInner γ mO' mLower x Hnlower ρ M.
Proof.
  intros n B mInner γ mO mO' mLower x Hnlower ρ M Hle1 Hle2 Hno Hmay HLRM.
  unfold LRM in *. destruct HLRM as [H1 H2]. split.
  - intro Hstrict. destruct (H1 Hstrict) as [E1 E2]. split; [exact E1 |].
    intro nb. destruct (E2 nb) as [f | (T & ev & lr)].
    + left; exact f.
    + right. exists T. split; [exact ev |].
      assert (Heq : down_clos mO' (mO T↓ T) = (mO' T↓ T)) by (apply @down_clos_comp2; exact Hle2).
      rewrite <- Heq. apply Hno; exact lr.
  - intro Hns. destruct (H2 Hns) as [f | (T & ev & lr)].
    + left; exact f.
    + right. exists T. split; [exact ev |].
      assert (Heq : down_clos mO' (mO T↓ T) = (mO' T↓ T)) by (apply @down_clos_comp2; exact Hle2).
      rewrite <- Heq. apply Hmay; exact lr.
Qed.

Lemma LRM_ud : forall {n} q (B : Ty n CompFlag) mInner (γ : attrs mInner) mO mLower (x : fin mLower)
  (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner) (ρ : env mInner) (M : Comp mInner),
  mO <= n ->
  (forall C, LR_no (up_Ty q B) C mLower x -> LR_no B (down_clos mO C) mLower x) ->
  (forall C, LR_maybe (up_Ty q B) C mLower x -> LR_maybe B (down_clos mO C) mLower x) ->
  LRM (up_Ty q B) LR_maybe LR_no mInner γ mO mLower x Hnlower ρ M ->
  LRM B LR_maybe LR_no mInner γ mO mLower x Hnlower ρ M.
Proof.
  intros n q B mInner γ mO mLower x Hnlower ρ M Hle Hno Hmay HLRM.
  unfold LRM in *. destruct HLRM as [H1 H2]. split.
  - intro Hstrict. destruct (H1 Hstrict) as [E1 E2]. split.
    + intro bnf. apply E1. apply (proj2 (non_func_up q B)). exact bnf.
    + intro nb.
      destruct (E2 (fun h => nb (proj1 (non_func_up q B) h))) as [f | (T & ev & lr)].
      * left; exact f.
      * right. exists T. split; [exact ev |].
        assert (Heq : down_clos mO (mO T↓ T) = (mO T↓ T)) by (apply @down_clos_idem).
        rewrite <- Heq. apply Hno; exact lr.
  - intro Hns. destruct (H2 Hns) as [f | (T & ev & lr)].
    + left; exact f.
    + right. exists T. split; [exact ev |].
      assert (Heq : down_clos mO (mO T↓ T) = (mO T↓ T)) by (apply @down_clos_idem).
      rewrite <- Heq. apply Hmay; exact lr.
Qed.
EOF

Require Export strictness.cbpv.typing strictness.cbpv.semantics.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import Coq.Logic.Eqdep_dec.

Require Import Coq.Arith.Peano_dec.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Require Import Psatz.

Definition non_func {n} (B : CompTy n) :=
  forall q A B', B <> CAbs q A B'.

Definition LRM {n} (B : Ty n CompFlag)
  (LR_maybe : Ty n CompFlag -> Clos CompFlag -> forall m,fin m -> Prop)
  (LR_no : Ty n CompFlag -> Clos CompFlag -> forall m,fin m -> Prop)
 mInner (γ : attrs mInner) mOuter mLower x (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner) ρ M :=
  ((down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) x = Strict ->
    (non_func B -> EvalCompFail ρ M) /\
    (~ non_func B -> EvalCompFail ρ M \/ exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\
      LR_no B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower x)) /\
  ((down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) x <> Strict ->
    EvalCompFail ρ M \/ exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\ LR_maybe B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower x).

Fixpoint LR_maybe {n k} (τ : Ty n k) (C : Clos k) mLower (x : fin mLower) :=
    (match τ in Ty _ k return Clos k -> Prop with
    | VUnit => fun C => C = Unit
    | VThunk γ B => fun C =>
      exists mOuter mInner γScoped γInner ρ M (HInner : mOuter <= mInner)
        (Hn : mOuter <= n) (HLower : mLower <= mOuter) (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner),
        down_env_until γ mOuter Hn = γScoped /\
        down_env_until γInner mOuter HInner = γScoped /\
        C = Thunk mOuter mInner γScoped ρ M /\
        LRM B LR_maybe LR_no mInner γInner mOuter mLower x Hnlower ρ M
    | VProd A1 A2 => fun C => exists W1 W2,
      C = Pair W1 W2 /\ LR_maybe A1 W1 mLower x /\ LR_maybe A2 W2 mLower x
    | VSum A1 A2 => fun C => exists W',
      (C = Inl W' /\ LR_maybe A1 W' mLower x) \/ (C = Inr W' /\ LR_maybe A2 W' mLower x)
    | CF A => fun C => exists W, C = Return W /\ LR_maybe A W mLower x
    | CAbs q A B => fun C =>
      exists mOuter mInner γScoped γInner ρ M (Hn : mOuter <= n)
        (HInner : mOuter <= mInner) (HLower : mLower <= mOuter) (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner),
      down_env_until γInner mOuter HInner = γScoped /\
      C = Closure mOuter mInner γScoped ρ M /\
      (forall W, LR_maybe A W mLower x ->
        EvalCompFail ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M \/
        exists T, EvalComp (q .: γInner) ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M T /\ LR_maybe B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower x)
    end) C

with LR_no {n k} (τ : Ty n k) (C : Clos k) mLower (x : fin mLower) :=
    (match τ in Ty _ k return Clos k -> Prop with
    | CAbs q A B => fun C =>
      exists mOuter mInner γScoped γInner ρ M (Hn : mOuter <= n) (HInner : mOuter <= mInner)
        (HLower : mLower <= mOuter) (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner),
      down_env_until γInner mOuter HInner = γScoped /\
      C = Closure mOuter mInner γScoped ρ M /\
      (forall W, LR_maybe A W mLower x ->
        (non_func B -> EvalCompFail ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M) /\
        (~ non_func B -> EvalCompFail ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M \/
            exists T, EvalComp (q .: γInner) ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M T /\ LR_no B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower x))
    | _ => fun C => False
    end) C.

Definition ρ_not_ok {n} γ (ρ : env n) (Γ : context n) mLower (x : fin mLower) (Hnlower : mLower <= n) :=
    (down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) x = Strict /\
    (down_env_until ρ mLower Hnlower) x = Absent /\
    (forall (j : fin n), j <> up_fin_until n Hnlower x -> LR_maybe (Γ j) (ρ j) mLower x).

Definition ρ_maybe_ok {n} γ (ρ : env n) (Γ : context n) mLower (x : fin mLower) (Hnlower : mLower <= n) :=
    (down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) x <> Strict /\
    (down_env_until ρ mLower Hnlower) x = Absent /\
    (forall (j : fin n), j <> up_fin_until n Hnlower x -> LR_maybe (Γ j) (ρ j) mLower x).

Definition SemVWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) V (A : ValTy n) :=
    forall ρ mLower x (Hnlower : mLower <= n),
        (ρ_not_ok γ ρ Γ mLower x Hnlower -> EvalValFail ρ V) /\
        (ρ_maybe_ok γ ρ Γ mLower x Hnlower ->
          EvalValFail ρ V \/ exists W, EvalVal γ ρ V W /\ LR_maybe A W mLower x).

Definition SemCWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) M (B : CompTy n) :=
    forall ρ mLower x (Hnlower : mLower <= n),

            (non_func B -> EvalCompFail ρ M) /\
            (~ non_func B -> EvalCompFail ρ M \/ exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\ LR_no B T mLower x)) /\
        (ρ_maybe_ok γ ρ Γ mLower x Hnlower ->
            EvalCompFail ρ M \/ exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\ LR_maybe B T mLower x).

Definition context n : Type := fin n -> ValTy n.

Inductive VWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Val n -> ValTy n -> Prop :=
  | T_Var i A :
    A = Γ i ->
    γ = (lazyvector <- Strict @ i) ->

    VWt γ Γ (vVar i) A

  | T_Unit :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ vUnit VUnit

  | T_Thunk γ' M B :
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ (vThunk M) (VThunk γ' B)

  | T_Pair γ1 γ2 V1 V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V1 A1 ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V2 A2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vPair V1 V2) (VProd A1 A2)

  | T_Inl V1 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V1 A1 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInl V1) (VSum A1 A2)

  | T_Inr V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V2 A2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInr V2) (VSum A1 A2)

  | T_Ret V A :
    VWt γ Γ V A ->

    CWt γ Γ (cRet V) (CF A)

  | T_Let q M M' A B B' γ1 γ2:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CF A) ->
    CWt (q .: γ2) (ctx_insert A Γ) M' B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cLet M M') B

  | T_Force V B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VThunk γ2 B) ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cForce V) B

  | T_Seq V M B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V VUnit ->
    CWt γ2 Γ M B ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSeq V M) B

  | T_Split q1 q2 V M γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B':
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VProd A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2)) (ctx_insert (Lazy A↑ A1) (ctx_insert A2 Γ)) M B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (le_succ_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSplit V M) B

  | T_Case q1 q2 V M1 M2 γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B1 B2:
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VSum A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A1 Γ) M1 B1 ->
    CWt (q2 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A2 Γ) M2 B2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B1 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B2 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cCase V M1 M2) B

  | T_Abs q M A B B' :
    CWt (q .: γ) (ctx_insert A Γ) M B' ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cAbs M) (CAbs q A B)

  | T_App M q V γ1 γ2 A B:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CAbs q A B) ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V A ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cApp M V) B

  | T_CSub M γ' B:
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ γ<= γ' ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSub M) B
.

Scheme VWt_ind' := Induction for VWt Sort Prop
    with CWt_ind' := Induction for CWt Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme Wt_mutual from VWt_ind', CWt_ind'.

Lemma LRM_up : forall {n} q (B : Ty n CompFlag) mInner (γ : attrs mInner) mO mLower (x : fin mLower)
  (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner) (ρ : env mInner) (M : Comp mInner),
  (forall C, LR_maybe B C mLower x -> LR_maybe (up_Ty q B) C mLower x) ->
  (forall C, LR_no B C mLower x -> LR_no (up_Ty q B) C mLower x) ->
  LRM B LR_maybe LR_no mInner γ mO mLower x Hnlower ρ M ->
  LRM (up_Ty q B) LR_maybe LR_no mInner γ mO mLower x Hnlower ρ M.
Proof.
  intros n q B mInner γ mO mLower x Hnlower ρ M Hmay Hno HLRM.
  unfold LRM in *. destruct HLRM as [H1 H2]. split.
  - intro Hstrict. destruct (H1 Hstrict) as [E1 E2]. split.
    + intro bnf. apply E1. apply (proj1 (non_func_up q B)). exact bnf.
    + intro nb.
      destruct (E2 (fun h => nb (proj2 (non_func_up q B) h))) as [f | (T & ev & lr)].
      * left; exact f.
      * right. exists T. split; [exact ev | apply Hno; exact lr].
  - intro Hns. destruct (H2 Hns) as [f | (T & ev & lr)].
    + left; exact f.
    + right. exists T. split; [exact ev | apply Hmay; exact lr].
Qed.

  intros n B mInner γ mO mO' mLower x Hnlower ρ M Hle1 Hle2 Hno Hmay HLRM.

Lemma up_fin_until_succ : forall {n} m (H : m <= n) (H' : m <= S n) (i : fin m),
  @up_fin_until m (S n) H' i = Some (@up_fin_until m n H i).
Proof.
  intros n m H H' i. unfold up_fin_until.
  generalize (le_minus_plus m (S n) H') as e1.
  generalize (le_minus_plus m n H) as e2.
  rewrite (Nat.sub_succ_l m n H). cbn. intros e2 e1.

Wt_mutual : forall (P : forall n γ Γ V A, VWt γ Γ V A -> Prop) (Q : forall n γ Γ M B, CWt γ Γ M B -> Prop), ... → forall n γ Γ V A (H : VWt γ Γ V A), P ... H and similarly. From strictness Require Import Task.
From strictness Require Import cbpv.strict_semtyping.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

(* ===== small helpers ===== *)
Lemma non_func_CF : forall {n} (A : Ty n ValFlag), non_func (CF A).
Proof. intros n A q A' B' E. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma non_func_thunk : forall {n} (γ : attrs n) (B : Ty n CompFlag), non_func (VThunk γ B).
Proof. intros n γ B q A' B' E. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma not_non_func_CAbs : forall {n} q (A : Ty n ValFlag) (B : Ty n CompFlag),
  ~ non_func (CAbs q A B).
Proof. intros n q A B H. unfold non_func in H. exact (H q A B eq_refl). Qed.

Lemma attr_add_nstrict_l : forall a b, a C+ b <> Strict -> a <> Strict.
Proof. intros a b H E. apply H. rewrite E. destruct b; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma attr_add_nstrict_r : forall a b, a C+ b <> Strict -> b <> Strict.
Proof. intros a b H E. apply H. rewrite E. destruct a; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma down_env_add_strict : forall {n} (γ1 γ2 : attrs n) mL (H : mL <= n) x,
  down_env_until (γ1 γ+ γ2) mL H x = Strict ->
  down_env_until γ1 mL H x = Strict \/ down_env_until γ2 mL H x = Strict.
Proof.
  intros n γ1 γ2 mL H x Hs. rewrite down_env_add in Hs.
  apply attr_add_strict_l. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma down_env_add_nstrict_l : forall {n} (γ1 γ2 : attrs n) mL (H : mL <= n) x,
  down_env_until (γ1 γ+ γ2) mL H x <> Strict ->
  down_env_until γ1 mL H x <> Strict.
Proof.
  intros n γ1 γ2 mL H x Hns E. apply Hns. rewrite down_env_add, E.
  destruct (down_env_until γ2 mL H x); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma down_env_add_nstrict_r : forall {n} (γ1 γ2 : attrs n) mL (H : mL <= n) x,
  down_env_until (γ1 γ+ γ2) mL H x <> Strict ->
  down_env_until γ2 mL H x <> Strict.
Proof.
  intros n γ1 γ2 mL H x Hns E. apply Hns. rewrite down_env_add, E.
  destruct (down_env_until γ1 mL H x); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma down_env_cons_strict : forall {n} (γ : attrs n) q mL (H : mL <= n) (H' : mL <= S n) x,
  down_env_until (q .: γ) mL H' x = down_env_until γ mL H x.
Proof. intros. apply down_env_cons. Qed.

(* ===== cond: context extension ===== *)
Lemma rho_not_ok_cons : forall {n} (γ : attrs n) (ρ : env n) (Γ : context n)
  mL x (H : mL <= n) (H' : mL <= S n) q (A : ValTy n) (W : ClosValue),
  ρ_not_ok γ ρ Γ mL x H ->
  LR_maybe A W mL x ->
  ρ_not_ok (q .: γ) (W .: ρ) (ctx_insert A Γ) mL x H'.
Proof.
  intros n γ ρ Γ mL x H H' q A W [Hs [Ha Hc]] HW. split; [| split].
  - rewrite down_env_cons. exact Hs.
  - rewrite down_env_cons. exact Ha.
  - intros [j'|] Hj.
    + cbn. apply LRprops_Um. apply Hc.
      intro E. apply Hj. rewrite up_fin_until_succ. rewrite E. reflexivity.
    + cbn. apply LRprops_Um. exact HW.
Qed.

Lemma rho_maybe_ok_cons : forall {n} (γ : attrs n) (ρ : env n) (Γ : context n)
  mL x (H : mL <= n) (H' : mL <= S n) q (A : ValTy n) (W : ClosValue),
  ρ_maybe_ok γ ρ Γ mL x H ->
  LR_maybe A W mL x ->
  ρ_maybe_ok (q .: γ) (W .: ρ) (ctx_insert A Γ) mL x H'.
Proof.
  intros n γ ρ Γ mL x H H' q A W [Hs [Ha Hc]] HW. split; [| split].
  - rewrite down_env_cons. exact Hs.
  - rewrite down_env_cons. exact Ha.
  - intros [j'|] Hj.
    + cbn. apply LRprops_Um. apply Hc.
      intro E. apply Hj. rewrite up_fin_until_succ. rewrite E. reflexivity.
    + cbn. apply LRprops_Um. exact HW.
Qed.

(* ===== cond: double context extension (for split) ===== *)
Lemma up_fin_until_ss : forall {n} m (H : m <= n) (H'' : m <= S (S n)) (i : fin m),
  @up_fin_until m (S (S n)) H'' i = Some (Some (@up_fin_until m n H i)).
Proof.
  intros n m H H'' i.
  set (H' := Nat.le_trans m n (S n) H (le_succ_r n)).
  rewrite (up_fin_until_succ (n := S n) (m := m) H' H'' i).
  rewrite (up_fin_until_succ (n := n) (m := m) H H' i). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rho_not_ok_double : forall {n} (γ : attrs n) (ρ : env n) (Γ : context n)
  mL x (H : mL <= n) (H'' : mL <= S (S n)) q1 q2
  (A1 A2 : Ty n ValFlag) (W1 W2 : ClosValue),
  ρ_not_ok γ ρ Γ mL x H ->
  LR_maybe A1 W1 mL x -> LR_maybe A2 W2 mL x ->
  ρ_not_ok (q1 .: (q2 .: γ)) (W1 .: (W2 .: ρ))
    (ctx_insert (Lazy A↑ A1) (ctx_insert A2 Γ)) mL x H''.
Proof.
  intros n γ ρ Γ mL x H H'' q1 q2 A1 A2 W1 W2 [Hs [Ha Hc]] HW1 HW2.
  split; [| split].
  - rewrite down_env_cons, down_env_cons. exact Hs.
  - rewrite down_env_cons, down_env_cons. exact Ha.
  - intros [ [j'|] | ] Hj.
    + cbn. apply LRprops_Um. apply LRprops_Um. apply Hc.
      intro E. apply Hj. rewrite up_fin_until_ss. rewrite E. reflexivity.
    + cbn. apply LRprops_Um. apply LRprops_Um. exact HW2.
    + cbn. apply LRprops_Um. apply LRprops_Um. exact HW1.
Qed.

Lemma rho_maybe_ok_double : forall {n} (γ : attrs n) (ρ : env n) (Γ : context n)
  mL x (H : mL <= n) (H'' : mL <= S (S n)) q1 q2
  (A1 A2 : Ty n ValFlag) (W1 W2 : ClosValue),
  ρ_maybe_ok γ ρ Γ mL x H ->
  LR_maybe A1 W1 mL x -> LR_maybe A2 W2 mL x ->
  ρ_maybe_ok (q1 .: (q2 .: γ)) (W1 .: (W2 .: ρ))
    (ctx_insert (Lazy A↑ A1) (ctx_insert A2 Γ)) mL x H''.
Proof.
  intros n γ ρ Γ mL x H H'' q1 q2 A1 A2 W1 W2 [Hs [Ha Hc]] HW1 HW2.
  split; [| split].
  - rewrite down_env_cons, down_env_cons. exact Hs.
  - rewrite down_env_cons, down_env_cons. exact Ha.
  - intros [ [j'|] | ] Hj.
    + cbn. apply LRprops_Um. apply LRprops_Um. apply Hc.

    + cbn. apply LRprops_Um. apply LRprops_Um. exact HW2.
    + cbn. apply LRprops_Um. apply LRprops_Um. exact HW1.
Qed.
EOF

From strictness Require Import Task.
From strictness Require Import cbpv.strict_semtyping.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Lemma LR_no_maybe : forall {n} (B : Ty n CompFlag) C mL x, LR_no B C mL x -> LR_maybe B C mL x.
Proof.
  intros n B. induction B as [| | | | q A IHA B IHB | A IHA]; intros C mL x H; cbn in *;
    try (destruct H); try (destruct H as (mO & mI & gS & gI & r & M & Hn & HI & HL & Hnl & Hd & HC & Hbody)).
  destruct H as (xO & xI & gS & gI & r & Mc & Hn & HI & HL & Hnl & Hrest).
  destruct Hrest as [HC Hbody].
  exists x0, xO, xI, gS, gI, r, M, Hn, HI, HL.
  split; [exact Hnl | split; [exact HC |]].
  intros W HWA.
  destruct (Hbody W HWA) as [Hnf Hnnf].
  destruct B.
  - left. exact (Hnf (non_func_CF A0)).
  - right. destruct (Hnnf (not_non_func_CAbs q0 A0 B0)) as [Hf | (T & ev & lr)].
    + left. exact Hf.
    + right. exists T. split; [exact ev | exact (IHB T mL x lr)].
Qed.
Print Assumptions LR_no_maybe.
